IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CRIMINAL WRIT PETITION NO. 3879 OF 2024
Neema Sanjay Rangari & Anr. … Petitioners
V/s.
The State of Maharashtra & Anr. … Respondents
Mr. Ashwin Thool a/w. Mr. Sarthak Bharsakle i/b. Ms. Archismati 
Chandramore for Petitioners.
Mr. Ashish I. Satpute, A.P .P . for Respondent No.1-State.
A.C.P . Mr. Shashikant Mane, Dadar Division, Mumbai, present. 
CORAM   : A. S. GADKARI AND
DR. NEELA GOKHALE, JJ.
DATE       : 9th September 2024. 
P.C. :
1) Issue notice to Respondent No.2, returnable on 21 st October 2024.
Hamdast permitted. 
2) Till the returnable date, investigation of the crime to continue,
however the Investigating Agency shall not file chargesheet, without leave  of
this Court. 
3) Stand over to 21 st October 2024.
     ( DR. NEELA GOKHALE, J. ) ( A.S. GADKARI, J. )
